text: In the doctors room, Holmes found a large iron safe, a small saucer of milk, and a dog whip tied into a loop. <break time="0.8s" /> We have no cat in the house, but there is a cheetah, said Helen, and Holmes looked at the milk with great interest. <break time="0.8s" /> Did you know that the bed in your sisters room is fastened to the floor, Holmes asked Helen as we left. <break time="0.8s" /> A bed that cannot move, a rope that does not ring, and a hole into the next room are not just accidents. <break time="0.8s" /> That night we waited at the village inn until a single light shone from Helens window, the signal that we had agreed on. <break time="0.8s" /> We crept into Julias room in the dark, and Holmes whispered that we must not make a sound or fall asleep. <break time="0.8s" /> Hour after hour passed in complete silence, and I heard the church clock strike midnight, then one, then two, then three. <break time="0.8s" /> Suddenly a light appeared in the ventilator, and we smelled burning oil and heated metal coming from the doctors room. <break time="0.8s" /> Then came a very gentle, soft sound, like a small jet of steam escaping from a kettle. <break time="0.8s" /> At that moment Holmes struck a match and hit hard at the bell rope with his cane, shouting, You see it, Watson.
